incident-bot: PAGER (sev2) - hosted-api-v2 - increased 5xx rate in us-west-2, routing timeouts and transient kernel failures. Paging oncall. https://status.redwood.example/INC-2026-0421 :rotating_light:

Alex S.: Oncall Alex here, picking this up. Jamal can you join for runtime/kernel checks? Priya can you start a quick customer-impact tally? :wave:

Jamal R.: on it. I'm looking at the runtime logs now. initial symptom: increased latency then a spike in 5xx (503/504) from inference pods, followed by broken model loads thrown by kernel-selector. Pulling last 10m logs.

Sofia L.: I'm toggling autoscaling thresholds and draining one of the nodes to see if requests failover cleanly. Will report back in 2m.

ops-bot: Deploy bot notice — new kernel-selection rollout (canary) completed 03:14 UTC to us-west-2 canary nodes. Triggered by CI pipeline #3721.

Alex S.: @Sofia L. hold on draining until we confirm rollback plan. Jamal, what's the error pattern? paste a snippet if you can.

Jamal R.: log snippet: ```
2026-04-21T03:25:12Z inference-runtime us-west-2 Pod/inf-23abc ERROR KernelSelectionError: incompatible-kernel: seq-len mismatch for model 'rw-instruct-v1'
2026-04-21T03:25:13Z inference-runtime us-west-2 Pod/inf-23abc WARN Eviction: api requests > 95th percentile latency 2.3s
2026-04-21T03:25:15Z gateway us-west-2 503 POST /v1/generate 120ms backend_error
```
Looks like the canary kernel rollout picked suboptimal kernels for some model variants and that led to increased backpressure and cascading 503s.

Priya M.: For customer impact, I'm pulling metrics now. Early numbers: ~280k requests affected in the window 03:20-03:30 UTC; error-rate for hosted-api-v2 in us-west-2 peaked at 6.8%. Top affected tenants: tenant-omega (5 min outage spike), tenant-lumen (partial errors). Support: I'm drafting an incident email.

Casey T.: Support triage — flagged 3 enterprise customers with >1% error rate. Reaching out via escalation playbook. CC'ing legal-team for potential SLA concerns.

Alex S.: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Roll back kernel-selection canary to previous stable profile 2) Route a fraction of traffic to dedicated fallback model (rw-instruct-v1-lite) to reduce load 3) Throttle long-running requests beyond 30s. Jamal, can you run rollback?

Jamal R.: Rolling back. Command I'm running: ```bash
kubectl -n inference set image ds/kernel-selector kernel-selector=registry.redwood/kernel-selector:stable-20260419
# wait for pods to restart
sleep 45
kubectl rollout status deploy/kernel-selector -n inference
```
I'll watch logs for error rate drop.

ops-bot: Action: autoscaler adjustments queued.

Sofia L.: I initiated traffic reroute to fallback model for 15% of requests: 
```json
{
  "route": "hosted-api-v2",
  "policy": {"fallback_model": "rw-instruct-v1-lite", "fraction": 0.15}
}
```
Response seems stable so far. Error-rate down to 2.1% after reroute.

Priya M.: Noting customer impact timeline: first anomalies at 03:22 UTC, spike peaked 03:26 UTC, mitigations (rollback + reroute) started 03:28 UTC, error-rate below 0.5% by 03:33 UTC.

Alex S.: Good. Can we capture exact counts for the RCA: total failed requests, affected customers, latency p95 before and after? Priya/Jamal own numbers.

Jamal R.: Collected: total failed requests in window 03:20-03:35 UTC = 278,412. Peak p95 latency pre-mitigation = 2.8s, post-mitigation = 410ms. Root cause preliminary: kernel-selector canary shipped a kernel-profile that mismatched sequence-length heuristics for rw-instruct-v1, causing suboptimal kernel paths and memory pressure -> increased evictions and 503s.

Alex S.: Ok next steps: schedule post-incident review + RCA writeup. I propose owners: Timeline & technical writeup — Jamal R.; Customer impact & communication — Priya M.; Mitigations & long-term fix (kanban/engineer) — Sofia L.; QA of RCA & signoff — Casey T.

Priya M.: I'll draft the customer-facing summary. Draft will include numbers and apology + what we did. Will share in #support-comms for review.

Casey T.: Added legal-team for SLA review. legal-team: please advise if we need to escalate to account managers for tenant-omega and tenant-lumen.

legal-team: Noted. We'll review once Priya posts the draft. Agenda item for postmortem: SLA impact calculation and credit guidance.

Alex S.: Scheduling — proposing a 1hr postmortem review at 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.example/pm-2089. If that time doesn't work, reply with availability before 2026-04-23. Please RSVP.

Sofia L.: I'm listing action items in the incident board. Quick wins: block canary kernel auto-rollouts for model families flagged as "sensitive"; add pre-rollout sequence-length compatibility test; add automatic fallback routing on kernel-selector errors.

Jamal R.: I'll draft the technical timeline and include kernel-selector rollout steps + CI job id #3721. Also including logs and the exact kernel image hash that caused issue.

Alex S.: Ownership confirmation: Jamal (RCA draft) / Priya (customer comms) / Sofia (remediation PR + perf test) / Casey (RCA QA & signoff) / Alex (postmortem host). Please update threads when you post drafts.

Priya M.: Draft customer note posted to #support-comms (link) — request reviews.

Jamal R.: RCA draft is here: https://docs.internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-0421-draft — please comment. Key contributing factors section will include: 1) canary rollout gating too weak 2) missing seq-len compatibility tests 3) insufficient early-warning on kernel-selector anomalies.

Casey T.: I'll do a peer review after the draft is fleshed out. Expected signoff timeline: 48 hours after draft shared.

Alex S.: Final note: tagging this as Sev2 -> root-cause review required. Please add any latency artifacts, flamegraphs, or perf traces to the RCA doc. Closing the pager for now since error-rate is under threshold and mitigations stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager closed by Alex S. at 03:36 UTC — duration 14m. Incident reference INC-2026-0421.

Priya M.: I'll follow up with affected customers and post the support outreach summary in the RCA doc.

Sofia L.: Creating remediation PRs: #4278 (disable auto-canary for seq-sensitive models) and #4279 (add unit test for kernel-selection seq-len fingerprint). Assigning to eng-runtime. ETA for merge: 2026-04-25.

Alex S.: Thanks team. We'll reconvene at the postmortem. If anyone needs to add evidence, drop in the RCA doc.

Casey T.: Marking action items with owners and due dates in the incident board. (reacts: :spiral_note_pad:)
